name: Nietzsche
q: There are no facts, only interpretations
Who has a why can bear any how
Without music, life would be a mistake
Where you cannot love, pass by
One must have chaos to birth a star
What's done from love is beyond good and evil
Gaze into the abyss; it gazes back
I am not a man, I am dynamite
Man is something that shall be overcome
All truly great thoughts are conceived by walking
The body is a great reason
If you would go high, use your own legs
Higher the tree, darker its roots
Let that day be lost to us on which we did not dance once
